note: No source I opened dates the GPT-6 Pro tier itself, so release is null and the base model's date is not copied. The OpenAI help article 'GPT-6 and other models in ChatGPT' (https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001354) and the ChatGPT release notes (https://help.openai.com/en/articles/6825453-chatgpt-release-notes) both returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch, so their contents are unverified. Search snippets title the help article 'GPT-5.6 and GPT-6 Pro in ChatGPT' and a search summary says GPT-6 Pro is 'powered by GPT-6 Astra' and available on Pro $100, Pro $200, Business and Enterprise, but none gives a launch date for the tier. Base model GPT-6 Astra: unopened third-party reports date its launch to September 3, 2026 (Tech Insider; Barron's via Yonhap), which concerns the base model, not the tier. Reports conflict: a DataLearner page lists GPT-6.1 Astra on November 4, 2026 and says a September 28 report claimed it was cancelled. A search summary also says the Pro reasoning option 'continues to use GPT-6 Astra' in the October 7 Chat-tab rollout, which suggests the Pro option existed before October 7, but no source dates it. Settling the date needs the OpenAI help article or release notes, which were not reachable from this environment.
